summary.text: David R. "Davey" Hiott is a Republican from Pickens who represents House District 4 (Pickens County) in the South Carolina House of Representatives, where he has served since 2005 and is Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: Hiott was born October 20, 1960, in Easley, graduated from Central Wesleyan College with a B.A. in 1983, and owns Hiott Printing Company.
He serves on the House Rules and Ways and Means committees.
His page lists past service on the Pickens County YMCA board of directors, membership in the Pickens Rotary Club, and service as a deacon at Pickens First Baptist Church.
